Chapter V, Theorem 3.23: Frobenius density for the induced determinant identity

decisive_checks: At odd ramified primes the quadratic residue character has the required restriction to rational units; at 2 the rational character factors through (Z/8)^times and extends inside the finite abelian group (O_K/8)^times of order 32.
The exceptional unit groups in Q(i) and Q(sqrt(-3)) are prescribed before extension. Their intersections with rational units modulo 8 or 9 are exactly {1,-1}; compatibility follows from eta_p(-1)=-1.
The prime-to-ell exponent is 32, or 54 when discriminant is -3. The hypotheses ell odd and ell not dividing the discriminant exclude every prime factor of the relevant exponent.

The principal-ideal character tau(a)/nu(a) is well defined on the actual ordinary ideal class group. Independent cyclic factors and their root relations give a genuine extension. Class-group ell-torsion only enlarges the coefficient field and adds no inertia.
The explicit idele formula is independent of the correcting element, trivial on principal ideles, continuous, and has exactly infinity type (-1,0) and conductor supported on the discriminant.

The explicit CHT Lemma 4.1.3 avatar matches the original geometric-Artin IsLAdicOf formula, with the infinity exponents negated relative to the CHT m convention; arithmetic Frobenius therefore has value psi(q)^(-1).
The split determinant is q^(-1), and the inert determinant has the necessary induced-coset minus sign cancelling psi((q))=-q. Chebotarev gives det Ind(kappa)=epsilon^(-1) globally.
The induced determinant formula for every element outside G_K gives the full transfer identity kappa(t^2)=-epsilon(t)^(-1); substituting t=sc proves the exact conjugation pairing for the original c.
The valuation-subring inertia contract includes every finite place and the trivial valuation. No field extension of K, class-number restriction, or uniform coefficient-degree claim was introduced.

independently_rerun_checker.interpretation: Finite diagnostics and source authentication supplement the written general proof; they are not themselves a proof for all fields.

remaining_frontier: This supplies Twist and the original rank-two seed twist. It does not by itself construct marked characteristic-prime support or prove two-sided integral rigidity and uniform Selmer bounds.
